title: Area, Perimeter & Volume
description: Circles, Pythagoras’ theorem, surface area and volume, units of area and volume, similar solids, and compound units.
objectives: Find the area and circumference of a circle
Use Pythagoras’ theorem to find a missing side
Find the surface area of a prism and a cylinder
Find the volume of any prism, including a cylinder
Convert between small and large units of measurement
Convert units of area and volume, and use the scale factors of similar solids
Use and convert compound units such as speed and density
